newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Cathay, Air HK seek 10pct ex-Europe cargo.
newsitem.headline: Cathay, Air HK seek 10pct ex-Europe cargo.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Air Hong Kong are planning a 10 percent rise in air cargo rates from several key ex-Europe centres, Cathay Pacific's Netherlands cargo manager, Achim van der Graaff said.
Germany, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands are all aiming for the 10 percent increase from October 1, he told Reuters.
"We have started to talk to the major clients concerning the increase and we will inform all of the market by the end of August to give the agents plenty of notice," he said.
Flights are full to all destinations, he added, with July this year being the one of the top months ever for Cathay Pacific in the Netherlands.
Japan, Hong Kong and Australia are particularly strong markets, he said.
